'''Dermatoglyphic identification''',<ref name="TA">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref> also known as a '''fingerprint scan'''<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> was a form of physical and biological identification employed throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and was used on [[Species/Legends|species]] that developed [[dermatoglyphic pattern]]s.<ref name="TA" />

It was considered to be one of the best identification systems in use, although it was not as precise as a [[Retinal scan/Legends|retinal scan]]. The limitations of the system meant that dermatoglyphic identification could not differentiate between [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]. In cases where species did not develop dermatoglyphic patterns, [[cytoplasmic biopsy]] and [[chitinous accretion analysis]] were amongst the alternative methods used for identifying them.<ref name="TA" />

Fingerprint scans could be used as a secondary identification system to activate vehicles that had been disabled by the [[BiVVol RVR-325]] vehicle voice lock.<ref name="GFT" />
